  <link rel="shortcut icon" type="image/png" href="/assets/choco-app-icon.png?v=20261101">

  <meta name="description" content="Choco AI, asisten AI utama dan representasi digital Choco dalam ekosistem The Choco Studios (TCS).">
  <title>Choco AI</title>

  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #080b14;
      --sidebar: #0c101c;
      --panel: #111625;
      --panel-hover: #171e31;
      --border: rgba(255,255,255,.075);
      --text: #eef2ff;
      --muted: #8993ad;
      --blue: #638cff;
      --purple: #a16bff;
      --gradient: linear-gradient(115deg, #648bff, #a76cff);
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      min-height: 100vh;
      color: var(--text);
      background: var(--bg);
      font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system,
        BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    button, textarea {
      font: inherit;
    }

    button {
      color: inherit;
    }

    button:focus-visible,
    textarea:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--blue);
      outline-offset: 3px;
    }

    .app {
      display: flex;
      height: 100dvh;
      min-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    /* SIDEBAR */

    .sidebar {
      width: 258px;
      flex: 0 0 258px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      padding: 22px 14px 16px;
      background: rgba(12,16,28,.96);
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
      transition: width .25s ease, flex-basis .25s ease,
        transform .25s ease;
      z-index: 20;
    }

    .brand {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 11px;
      padding: 2px 8px 27px;
    }

    .brand-icon,
    .ai-avatar {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      background: var(--gradient);
      color: white;
      box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(111,112,255,.18);
    }

    .brand-icon {display:block;width:39px;height:39px;flex:0 0 39px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:14px;background:#2d3136;box-shadow:0 0 25px rgba(111,112,255,.18)}

    .brand-name {
      font-weight: 750;
      font-size: 17px;
      letter-spacing: -.5px;
    }

    .brand-version {
      display: block;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 500;
      margin-top: 3px;
    }

    .new-chat {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 9px;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(125,145,255,.28);
      border-radius: 13px;
      background: linear-gradient(
        110deg,
        rgba(89,119,255,.17),
        rgba(153,91,255,.12)
      );
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: .2s;
    }

    .new-chat:hover {
      border-color: rgba(145,145,255,.65);
      background: rgba(104,119,255,.2);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .nav-label {
      padding: 8px 11px;
      color: #66718c;
      font-size: 10px;
      letter-spacing: 1.6px;
      font-weight: 750;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .nav-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 11px 12px;
      margin: 2px 0;
      text-align: left;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      border-radius: 11px;
      background: transparent;
      color: #aab4cd;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 13px;
      transition: .2s;
    }

    .nav-item:hover,
    .nav-item.active {
      background: rgba(125,143,255,.09);
      border-color: rgba(125,143,255,.1);
      color: #fff;
    }

    .nav-icon {
      width: 20px;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    .soon-tag {
      margin-left: auto;
      color: #a4a9c0;
      font-size: 9px;
      padding: 3px 5px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 5px;
    }

    .recent-section {
      margin-top: 25px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .recent-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 3px;
      padding: 0 3px;
    }

    .recent-item {
      overflow: hidden;
      padding: 10px;
      color: #8d98b2;
      font-size: 12px;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
      border-radius: 9px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .recent-item:hover {
      color: white;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.04);
    }

    .sidebar-bottom {
      margin-top: auto;
      padding-top: 15px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .profile { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; padding:10px 8px; width:100%; text-align:left; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:12px; background:transparent; color:inherit; cursor:pointer; }
    .profile:hover,.profile[aria-expanded="true"] { background:rgba(255,255,255,.045); border-color:var(--border); }
    .profile-copy { display:flex; flex-direction:column; min-width:0; text-align:left; }
    .account-menu-wrap { position:relative; }
    .account-chevron { margin-left:auto; color:var(--muted); }
    .account-menu { position:absolute; left:0; bottom:calc(100% + 8px); width:100%; padding:7px; border:1px solid rgba(135,148,191,.22); border-radius:13px; background:#111827; box-shadow:0 18px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.4); z-index:40; }
    .account-menu[hidden] { display:none !important; }
    .account-menu-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; width:100%; padding:11px 10px; border:0; border-radius:9px; background:transparent; color:#e6ebfa; text-align:left; font-size:12px; cursor:pointer; }
    .account-menu-item:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,.07); }
    .memory-settings-empty { min-height:150px; }

    .profile-avatar {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 35px;
      height: 35px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #202a43;
      border: 1px solid #354362;
      color: #b9c8ff;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 750;
    }

    .profile-name {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .profile-sub {
      margin-top: 3px;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 10px;
    }
    .profile-copy { min-width: 0; }
    .profile-name, .profile-sub { max-width: 155px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

    /* MAIN LAYOUT */

    .main {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 0;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: hidden;
      background:
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at 50% -15%,
          rgba(68,85,180,.13),
          transparent 55%
        ),
        var(--bg);
    }

    .topbar {
      height: 66px;
      flex: 0 0 66px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0 27px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: rgba(8,11,20,.68);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
      z-index: 5;
    }

    .top-left,
    .top-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .page-title {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }


    .icon-button {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 37px;
      height: 37px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 11px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.025);
      color: #a9b4ce;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: .2s;
    }

    .icon-button:hover {
      color: white;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.08);
    }

    .status {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
      color: #a2adc4;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .status-dot {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #53dfa6;
      box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(83,223,166,.55);
    }

    /* CHAT AREA */

    .chat-scroll {
      flex: 1;
      min-height: 0;
      overflow-y: auto;
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      scrollbar-width: thin;
      scrollbar-color: #28314a transparent;
    }

    .chat-content {
      width: min(790px, 100%);
      min-height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 38px 27px 24px;
    }

    .welcome {
      margin: auto 0;
      padding: 28px 0 38px;
      animation: appear .65s ease both;
    }

    .welcome-mark {
      position: relative;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 66px;
      height: 66px;
      margin: 0 0 27px;
      border-radius: 23px;
      background: linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        rgba(98,137,255,.2),
        rgba(164,102,255,.17)
      );
      border: 1px solid rgba(138,133,255,.3);
      box-shadow:
        0 0 45px rgba(98,105,255,.13),
        inset 0 0 20px rgba(115,130,255,.08);
      overflow:hidden;object-fit:cover;
      animation: float 5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .welcome-mark::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: -7px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(137,129,255,.12);
      border-radius: 28px;
    }

    .eyebrow {
      margin-bottom: 13px;
      color: #a7a5ff;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 750;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .welcome h1 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: clamp(29px, 4vw, 43px);
      font-weight: 750;
      letter-spacing: -1.8px;
      line-height: 1.17;
    }

    .gradient-text {
      color: transparent;
      background: linear-gradient(
        100deg,
        #7ea5ff 10%,
        #b69aff 55%,
        #e2a5ff 100%
      );
      background-clip: text;
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
    }

    .welcome-description {
      max-width: 490px;
      margin: 17px 0 28px;
      color: #8f9ab5;
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.9;
    }

    .suggestion-label {
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      color: #79849e;
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .suggestions {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr));
      gap: 11px;
      max-width: 560px;
    }

    .suggestion {
      min-height: 88px;
      padding: 15px;
      text-align: left;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 14px;
      background: linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        rgba(255,255,255,.035),
        rgba(255,255,255,.012)
      );
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: .22s;
    }

    .suggestion:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
      border-color: rgba(126,139,255,.42);
      background: rgba(108,120,255,.075);
    }

    .suggestion-icon {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 9px;
      font-size: 18px;
    }

    .suggestion-title {
      display: block;
      color: #e1e7fa;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .suggestion-desc {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 5px;
      color: #7f8aa4;
      font-size: 10px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* ADSTERRA NATIVE BANNER */
    .native-ad-slot {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 100%;
      min-width: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      color: var(--muted);
    }
    .ad-rail { margin-top: 24px; padding-top: 19px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .ad-rail-heading { margin-bottom: 14px; color: #aab4ce; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .all-sizes-ad-slot { min-width: 0; }
    .all-sizes-ad-placeholder { min-height: 130px; display: grid; align-content: center; justify-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 16px 10px; text-align: center; border: 1px dashed rgba(135,148,191,.22); border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.015); color: #79849e; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.6; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
    .all-sizes-ad-placeholder span { color: #5e6a85; font-size: 10px; }
    .native-ad-slot[hidden], .sponsor-link-slot[hidden], .social-ad-note[hidden], .plus-menu[hidden] { display: none !important; }

    .native-ad-label {
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: #79849e;
      font-size: 10px;
      letter-spacing: .5px;
    }

    .native-ad-content {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 100%;
      min-width: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.015);
    }

    .sponsor-link-slot {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 100%;
      margin-top: 12px;
      padding: 11px 13px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 11px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.018);
      font-size: 11px;
    }

    .sponsor-link-slot[hidden] { display: none; }

    /* Slot iklan dipisahkan agar format berbentuk konten tidak saling menempel. */
    .ad-placement {
      display: block;
      position: relative;
      isolation: isolate;
      clear: both;
    }

    .ad-placement + .ad-placement { margin-top: 14px; }

    .ad-placement-label {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: #79849e;
      font-size: 9px;
      letter-spacing: .8px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .social-ad-note {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 100%;
      margin-top: 14px;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border: 1px dashed rgba(135,148,191,.18);
      border-radius: 10px;
      color: #79849e;
      font-size: 10px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .social-ad-note[hidden] { display: none; }

    .sponsor-link-label {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 5px;
      color: #79849e;
      font-size: 9px;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
    }

    .sponsor-link-slot a {
      color: #aebcff;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .sponsor-link-slot a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

    .preference-link {
      padding: 0;
      border: 0;
      background: transparent;
      color: #8f9bb8;
      text-decoration: underline;
      text-underline-offset: 2px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: inherit;
    }

    .preference-link:hover { color: #c2ccff; }

    /* MESSAGES */

    #messages {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 26px;
      padding: 10px 0 24px;
    }

    .message {
      display: flex;
      gap: 13px;
      max-width: 100%;
      animation: appear .25s ease both;
    }

    .message.user {
      justify-content: flex-end;
    }

    .message.user .message-body {
      max-width: 82%;
      padding: 13px 17px;
      color: #f3f4ff;
      background: linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        rgba(93,112,208,.22),
        rgba(121,89,178,.2)
      );
      border: 1px solid rgba(141,139,255,.16);
      border-radius: 18px 18px 5px 18px;
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.8;
      white-space: pre-wrap;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .ai-avatar {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 11px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .message.assistant {
      align-items: flex-start;
    }

    .message.assistant .message-body {
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 0;
      padding-top: 2px;
      color: #d8def0;
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.9;
      white-space: pre-wrap;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .message-name {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      color: #aeb8d1;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 750;
    }

    .message.error .message-body {
      color: #ffaaaa;
    }

    .typing {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      height: 23px;
    }

    .typing span {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      background: #8d9bff;
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .typing span:nth-child(2) {
      animation-delay: .15s;
    }

    .typing span:nth-child(3) {
      animation-delay: .3s;
    }

    /* COMPOSER */

    .composer-wrap {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      padding: 12px 24px 16px;
      background: linear-gradient(
        0deg,
        var(--bg) 70%,
        rgba(8,11,20,.88)
      );
    }

    .composer {
      width: min(790px, 100%);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .input-box {
      position: relative;
      padding: 13px 14px 10px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(135,148,191,.19);
      border-radius: 19px;
      background: linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        rgba(20,27,44,.98),
        rgba(17,20,35,.98)
      );
      box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
      transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s;
    }

    .input-box:focus-within {
      border-color: rgba(116,139,255,.53);
      box-shadow:
        0 0 0 3px rgba(103,123,255,.06),
        0 10px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
    }

    #message {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 36px;
      max-height: 180px;
      resize: none;
      padding: 3px 3px 9px;
      border: 0;
      outline: 0;
      background: transparent;
      color: #f0f3ff;
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    #message::placeholder {
      color: #77829d;
    }

    .input-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .input-hints { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
    .plus-menu-wrap { position: relative; }
    .plus-trigger { width: 36px; height: 36px; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid rgba(135,148,191,.18); background: rgba(255,255,255,.025); font-size: 17px; }
    .plus-menu { position: absolute; z-index: 30; left: 0; bottom: calc(100% + 12px); width: min(280px, calc(100vw - 42px)); padding: 9px; border: 1px solid rgba(135,148,191,.2); border-radius: 15px; background: #111827; box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.42); }
    .plus-menu-heading { padding: 7px 9px 10px; color: #8995b0; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: .8px; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .plus-menu-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 9px; text-align: left; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #e6ebfa; cursor: pointer; }
    .plus-menu-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); }
    .plus-menu-item.model-choice[aria-pressed="true"] { background: rgba(99,140,255,.14); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(99,140,255,.38); }
    .plus-menu-item.model-choice[aria-pressed="true"] .plus-menu-icon { color: #fff; background: rgba(99,140,255,.2); }
    .plus-menu-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; flex: 0 0 34px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; color: #b9c5ff; }
    .plus-menu-item strong { display: block; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; }
    .plus-menu-item small { display: block; margin-top: 3px; color: #7f8aa4; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.4; }

    .tool-button {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 7px 9px;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      border-radius: 9px;
      background: transparent;
      color: #8d99b4;
      font-size: 11px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: .2s;
    }

    .tool-button:hover {
      color: #dce3ff;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.04);
    }

    .send-button {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: var(--gradient);
      color: white;
      font-size: 19px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(107,108,255,.2);
      transition: .2s;
    }

    .send-button:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(107,108,255,.38);
    }

    .send-button:disabled {
      opacity: .45;
      cursor: wait;
      transform: none;
    }

    .disclaimer {
      margin: 11px 0 0;
      color: #68738d;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 10px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* RIGHT PANEL */

    .right-panel {
      width: 300px;
      flex: 0 0 300px;
      padding: 25px 17px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      border-left: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: rgba(12,16,28,.58);
    }


    .identity-card { margin-bottom:22px; }
    .right-panel .identity-card { order:0; }
    .panel-heading {
      margin: 2px 0 18px;
      color: #aab4ce;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 750;
      letter-spacing: .9px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .identity-card {
      padding: 17px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(129,139,255,.18);
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: linear-gradient(
        145deg,
        rgba(105,116,255,.09),
        rgba(161,100,255,.035)
      );
    }

    .identity-logo {display:grid;place-items:center;width:42px;height:42px;margin-bottom:13px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:14px;background:#2d3136}
    .identity-logo img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}

    .identity-title {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 750;
    }

    .identity-description {
      margin-top: 8px;
      color: #8995b0;
      font-size: 11px;
      line-height: 1.8;

      const STORAGE_KEY = "tcs_license_request";
      const url = new URL(window.location.href);

      const urlRequestId = fragment.get("license_request") || url.searchParams.get("license_request") || "";
      const urlRequestToken = fragment.get("license_token") || url.searchParams.get("license_token") || "";

          showToast("Tautan permintaan lisensi tidak valid.");

        }
        sessionStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
          requestId: urlRequestId,
          requestToken: urlRequestToken,
          submitted: false,
          savedAt: Date.now()
        }));
        url.searchParams.delete("license_request");
        url.searchParams.delete("license_token");
        url.hash = "";
        window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, url.pathname + url.search);
      }

      let saved;
      try { saved = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || "null"); } catch { saved = null; }
      if (!saved || !saved.requestId || !saved.requestToken) return;
      const { requestId, requestToken } = saved;
      if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(requestId) || requestToken.length < 20 || requestToken.length > 200) {
        sessionStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        showToast("Data sesi permintaan lisensi tidak valid.");

      }

      const licenseCard = document.createElement("article");

            cache: "no-store",
            body: JSON.stringify({ action: "status", requestId, requestToken })
          });
          const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
          if (!response.ok || !data.ok) throw new Error(data.error || "Status permintaan tidak dapat diperiksa.");
          if (data.buyerDetailsReceived) {
            saved.submitted = true;
            updateSaved();
            buyerInput.disabled = true;

            sessionStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
          } else if (data.status === "expired") {
            referenceStatus.textContent = "Masa berlaku permintaan lisensi telah berakhir. Buat permintaan baru dari aplikasi produk.";
            stopPolling();
            sessionStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
          } else if (data.verificationStatus === "hold") {
            referenceStatus.textContent = "Permintaan ditahan untuk pemeriksaan tambahan. " + (data.verificationNote ? "Alasan: " + data.verificationNote : "Belum ada kunci yang dialokasikan.");
          } else if (data.verificationStatus === "verified") {
            referenceStatus.textContent = "Pembayaran telah diverifikasi. Permintaan menunggu persetujuan dan alokasi kunci oleh Owner.";
          } else if (data.buyerDetailsReceived) {
            referenceStatus.textContent = "Data pembelian diterima. Tim The Choco Studios akan mencocokkan transaksi dan memastikan dana telah diterima.";
          } else {
            referenceStatus.textContent = "Lengkapi username Projects.co.id dan ID transaksi agar permintaan dapat diperiksa.";
          }
          if (data.status === "pending" && (data.buyerDetailsReceived || saved.submitted) && !pollTimer) {
            pollTimer = window.setInterval(() => refreshStatus(true), 20000);
          }
        } catch (error) {
          if (!silent) referenceStatus.textContent = error.message || "Status belum dapat diperiksa. Coba kembali.";
        } finally {
          checking = false;
          checkButton.disabled = false;
          scrollToBottom();
        }
      };

      referenceForm.addEventListener("submit", async (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const buyerUsername = buyerInput.value.trim();
        const transactionReference = referenceInput.value.trim();
        if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{3,80}$/.test(buyerUsername) || transactionReference.length < 4 || transactionReference.length > 120) {
          referenceStatus.textContent = "Periksa kembali username dan ID transaksi yang dimasukkan.";
          return;
        }
        referenceButton.disabled = true;
        buyerInput.disabled = true;
        referenceInput.disabled = true;
        referenceStatus.textContent = "Mengirim data pembelian ke server lisensi...";
        try {
          const response = await fetch("/api/license", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            cache: "no-store",
            body: JSON.stringify({ action: "submit_purchase_reference", requestId, requestToken, buyerUsername, transactionReference })
          });
          const result = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
          if (!response.ok || !result.ok || !result.submitted) throw new Error(result.error || "Data pembelian belum berhasil disimpan.");
          saved.submitted = true;
          updateSaved();
          referenceButton.textContent = "Data pembelian terkirim";
          referenceStatus.textContent = "Data berhasil diterima. Tim The Choco Studios akan memeriksa transaksi secara manual di Projects.co.id.";
          await refreshStatus(true);
        } catch (error) {
          referenceStatus.textContent = error.message || "Data pembelian gagal dikirim. Silakan coba lagi.";
          referenceButton.disabled = false;
          buyerInput.disabled = false;
          referenceInput.disabled = false;
        }
        scrollToBottom();
      });

      checkButton.addEventListener("click", () => refreshStatus(false));
      if (saved.submitted) {
        buyerInput.disabled = true;
        referenceInput.disabled = true;
        referenceButton.disabled = true;
        referenceButton.textContent = "Data pembelian terkirim";
      }
      await refreshStatus(false);
      showToast("Permintaan lisensi terhubung. Lengkapi data pembelian untuk memulai pemeriksaan.");
    }
    handleTcsLicenseRequest();


    function showToast(message) {
      toast.textContent = message;
      toast.classList.add("show");

      clearTimeout(toastTimer);
      toastTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.remove("show");
      }, 2600);
    }

    function scrollToBottom() {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        chatScroll.scrollTop = chatScroll.scrollHeight;
      });
    }

    function closeSidebar() {
      sidebar.classList.remove("open");
      sidebarOverlay.classList.remove("open");
    }

      sidebar.classList.add("open");
      sidebarOverlay.classList.add("open");
    }

    sidebarOverlay.addEventListener("click", closeSidebar);

    function createChocoAvatar(label = "Logo Choco AI") {
      const image = document.createElement("img");
      image.src = "/assets/choco-app-icon.png?v=20261101"; image.alt = label; image.width = 32; image.height = 32;
      return image;
    }

    function renderAssistantText(container, text) {
      container.replaceChildren();
      const pattern = /(\[[^\]]+\]\(https?:\/\/[^\s)]+\)|https?:\/\/[^\s<>()]+|\*\*[^*]+\*\*|`[^`]+`)/g;
      let cursor = 0; const source = String(text);
      for (const match of source.matchAll(pattern)) {
        const token = match[0]; const index = match.index ?? 0;
        if (index > cursor) container.appendChild(document.createTextNode(source.slice(cursor, index)));
        const markdownLink = token.match(/^\[([^\]]+)\]\((https?:\/\/[^\s)]+)\)$/);
        if (markdownLink) {
          const anchor = document.createElement("a"); anchor.className = "assistant-link"; anchor.href = markdownLink[2]; anchor.target = "_blank";
          anchor.rel = "noopener noreferrer"; anchor.textContent = markdownLink[1]; container.appendChild(anchor);
        } else if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(token)) {
          const cleanUrl = token.replace(/[.,!?;:]+$/, ""); const anchor = document.createElement("a");
          anchor.className = "assistant-link"; anchor.href = cleanUrl; anchor.target = "_blank"; anchor.rel = "noopener noreferrer"; anchor.textContent = cleanUrl; container.appendChild(anchor);
          if (cleanUrl.length < token.length) container.appendChild(document.createTextNode(token.slice(cleanUrl.length)));
        } else if (token.startsWith("**")) {
          const strong = document.createElement("strong"); strong.textContent = token.slice(2, -2); container.appendChild(strong);
        } else { const code = document.createElement("code"); code.textContent = token.slice(1, -1); container.appendChild(code); }
        cursor = index + token.length;
      }
      if (cursor < source.length) container.appendChild(document.createTextNode(source.slice(cursor)));
    }
    function addMessage(text, role, options = {}) {
      const wrapper = document.createElement("article");
      wrapper.className = "message " + role;

      if (options.error) {
        wrapper.classList.add("error");
      }

      if (role === "assistant") {
        const avatar = document.createElement("div");
        avatar.className = "ai-avatar";
        avatar.appendChild(createChocoAvatar());

        const body = document.createElement("div");
        body.className = "message-body";

        const name = document.createElement("span");
        name.className = "message-name";
        name.textContent = "Choco AI";

        const content = document.createElement("div");
        renderAssistantText(content, text);

        body.append(name, content);
        wrapper.append(avatar, body);

        if (options.typing) {
          content.textContent = "";

          const dots = document.createElement("div");
          dots.className = "typing";
          dots.innerHTML = "<span></span><span></span><span></span>";
          content.appendChild(dots);
        }
      } else {
        const body = document.createElement("div");
        body.className = "message-body";
        body.textContent = text;
        wrapper.appendChild(body);
      }

      messages.appendChild(wrapper);
      scrollToBottom();
      return wrapper;
    }

    async function revealReply(text) {
      const wrapper = addMessage("", "assistant");
      const content = wrapper.querySelector(".message-body > div:last-child");
      if (!preferences.typingEffect) { renderAssistantText(content, text); return; }
      for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i += 4) {
        renderAssistantText(content, text.slice(0, i + 4));
        scrollToBottom();
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 12));
      }
    }
    function updateRecentTitle(title) {
      if (!conversationStarted) {
        conversationStarted = true;
        conversationTitle = title.slice(0, 36);

        recentList.replaceChildren();

        const item = document.createElement("div");
        item.className = "recent-item";
        item.textContent = conversationTitle;
        item.title = conversationTitle;
        item.addEventListener("click", () => {
          showToast("Riwayat ini hanya tersedia selama sesi halaman ini.");
        });

        recentList.appendChild(item);
      }
    }

    function resetChat() {
      if (busy) {
        showToast("Tunggu sampai jawaban selesai dulu.");
        return;
      }

      history = [];
      try { localStorage.removeItem(CONVERSATION_STORAGE_KEY); } catch {}
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("choco:new-chat"));
      conversationTitle = "";
      conversationStarted = false;

      messages.replaceChildren();
      welcome.style.display = "";
      updateWelcomeGreeting();
      input.value = "";
      input.style.height = "auto";

      recentList.replaceChildren();

      const empty = document.createElement("div");
      empty.className = "recent-item";
      empty.style.color = "#737f99";
      empty.textContent = "Belum ada obrolan";
      recentList.appendChild(empty);

      closeSidebar();
      input.focus();
      scrollToBottom();
    }

    function restoreCurrentConversation() {
      try {
        const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CONVERSATION_STORAGE_KEY) || "null");
        if (!saved || saved.version !== 1 || !Array.isArray(saved.history)) return;
        const restored = saved.history.filter(item =>
          item && (item.role === "user" || item.role === "assistant") &&
          typeof item.content === "string" && item.content.trim()
        ).slice(-48);
        if (!restored.length) return;
        history = restored;
        const firstUserMessage = restored.find(item => item.role === "user");
        if (firstUserMessage) updateRecentTitle(firstUserMessage.content);
        welcome.style.display = "none";
        restored.forEach(item => addMessage(item.content, item.role));
        scrollToBottom();
      } catch {
        try { localStorage.removeItem(CONVERSATION_STORAGE_KEY); } catch {}
      }
    }

    restoreCurrentConversation();
    window.addEventListener("storage", event => {
      if (event.key === "chocoNextAllowedAt" && event.newValue) {
        cooldownUntil = Math.max(cooldownUntil, Number(event.newValue) || 0);
        if (cooldownUntil > Date.now()) {
          if (cooldownTimer) clearInterval(cooldownTimer);
          updateSendCooldown();
          cooldownTimer = setInterval(updateSendCooldown, 250);
        }
      }
    });

    document.getElementById("clearChat").addEventListener("click", resetChat);

    document.querySelectorAll("[data-prompt]").forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        input.value = button.dataset.prompt;
        resizeInput();
        input.focus();
      });
    });

    document.querySelectorAll(".future-feature").forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener("click", event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        plusMenu.hidden = true;
        plusMenuButton.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
        showToast(
          button.dataset.feature + " belum aktif. Penempatan menunya sudah disiapkan, tetapi fungsi backend-nya belum tersedia."
        );
      });
    });

    document.querySelectorAll(".nav-item[data-page]").forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        document.querySelectorAll(".nav-item[data-page]").forEach(item => {
          item.classList.remove("active");
        });

        button.classList.add("active");
        closeSidebar();
        scrollToBottom();
      });
    });

    function resizeInput() {
      input.style.height = "auto";
      input.style.height = Math.min(input.scrollHeight, 180) + "px";
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", resizeInput);

    input.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
      if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
        event.preventDefault();

        if (!busy && Date.now() >= cooldownUntil) {
          form.requestSubmit();
        }
      }
    });

    form.addEventListener("submit", async event => {
      event.preventDefault();

      const message = input.value.trim();

      if (!message || busy) return;
      if (Date.now() < cooldownUntil) { updateSendCooldown(); showToast("Tunggu jeda 10 detik sebelum mengirim pesan berikutnya."); return; }

      const isOwnerCredentialCandidate = /^[A-Za-z0-9._~-]{8,200}$/.test(message);
      busy = true;
      send.disabled = true;
      welcome.style.display = "none";

      if (!isOwnerCredentialCandidate) {
        updateRecentTitle(message);
        addMessage(message, "user");
      }
      input.value = "";
      resizeInput();

      const waiting = addMessage("", "assistant", { typing: true });

      try {
        const response = await fetch("/api/chat", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            message,
            history,
            memories: [],
            preferences,
            modelMode
          })
        });

        let data;

        try {
          data = await response.json();
        } catch {
          throw new Error("Respons backend bukan JSON yang valid.");
        }

        waiting.remove();

        if (data.authAttempt === true) {
          await revealReply(typeof data.reply === "string" ? data.reply : "Verifikasi Owner selesai.");
          return;
        }

        if (!response.ok) {
          addMessage(
            data.error || "Permintaan gagal. Periksa konfigurasi backend.",
            "assistant",
            { error: true }
          );
          return;
        }

        const reply = typeof data.reply === "string"
          ? data.reply
          : "";

        if (!reply.trim()) {
          addMessage(
            "Model mengembalikan jawaban kosong. Coba kirim ulang pesan lu.",
            "assistant",
            { error: true }
          );
          return;
        }

        await revealReply(reply);

        history.push(
          { role: "user", content: message },
          { role: "assistant", content: reply }
        );

        // Simpan percakapan aktif agar konteks tidak hilang ketika halaman dimuat ulang.
        if (history.length > 48) history.splice(0, history.length - 48);
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(CONVERSATION_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
            version: 1,
            title: conversationTitle,
            history,
            updatedAt: Date.now()
          }));
        } catch {
          showToast("Percakapan tetap berjalan, tetapi penyimpanan riwayat browser tidak tersedia.");
        }

      } catch (error) {
        waiting.remove();

        addMessage(
          error.message || "Gagal menghubungi backend. Coba lagi nanti.",
          "assistant",
          { error: true }
        );
      } finally {
        busy = false;
        startSendCooldown();
        input.focus();
        scrollToBottom();
      }
    });

  </script>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const key = "choco_site_preferences_v1";
      const backdrop = document.getElementById("sitePreferenceBackdrop");
      const accept = document.getElementById("sitePreferenceAccept");
      const reject = document.getElementById("sitePreferenceReject");

      const sponsorLinkSlot = document.getElementById("sponsorLinkSlot");
      const preferencesLink = document.getElementById("openSitePreferences");
      const messages = document.getElementById("messages");
      const welcome = document.getElementById("welcome");
      let adsAllowed = false;

      function loadAds() {
        adsAllowed = true;
        if (sponsorLinkSlot) sponsorLinkSlot.hidden = false;
        if (typeof window.loadChocoNativeAd === "function") window.loadChocoNativeAd();
      }

      function saveChoice(allowed) {
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify({ adsAllowed: allowed, savedAt: new Date().toISOString() }));
        } catch (error) {
          backdrop.hidden = false;
          return;
        }
        const wasAllowed = adsAllowed;
        adsAllowed = allowed;
        backdrop.hidden = true;
        if (allowed) {
          loadAds();
        } else {
          if (sponsorLinkSlot) sponsorLinkSlot.hidden = true;
          // A third-party script already loaded cannot be reliably unloaded in place.
          if (wasAllowed) window.location.reload();
        }
      }

      let saved = null;
      try { saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || "null"); } catch (error) { saved = null; }
      if (saved && saved.adsAllowed === true) loadAds();
      else if (!saved || typeof saved.adsAllowed !== "boolean") backdrop.hidden = false;

      accept.addEventListener("click", () => saveChoice(true));
      reject.addEventListener("click", () => saveChoice(false));
      preferencesLink.addEventListener("click", () => { backdrop.hidden = false; });
    })();
  </script>
